format: single new traditional Subway restaurant (standard Franchise Agreement)

invest.quote: The initial investment necessary to begin operation of a single new Subway® franchise ranges from $263,000 to $630,000 ($227,000 to $458,000 for a non-traditional location). This sum includes an estimated $18,000 to $27,000 (including an initial franchise fee of $15,000) that must be paid to us or our affiliate.

fee.quote: Standard Franchise Fee $15,000 This is the standard franchise fee for a Subway® restaurant franchise for all first-time franchisees except: (i) qualified United States Armed Forces Veterans ("US Veterans")...
fee.note: Reduced fee of $7,500 for qualified existing franchisees buying additional restaurants, franchisees of affiliates, honorably discharged U.S. Veterans (first franchise) and qualified non-traditional locations; add-on fee $3,750 for a new individual owner under reduced fee; satellite fee $5,000 ($1,000 short-term); no fee for School Lunch / Community Development programs.

royalty.quote: Royalty 8% of total gross sales Payable weekly See Note 1

adFund.quote: Advertising 4.5% of total gross sales Payable weekly See Notes 1 and 2
adFund.note: Current franchise agreement fixes the advertising fund contribution at 4.5%; certain satellite/non-traditional restaurants may pay 0.5% to 2%; certain multi-unit developers 2% to 3.5%.

otherRecurring.name: Restaurant Technology Fee
otherRecurring.amount: $75 per month, subject to increases of up to 10% annually

otherRecurring.name: Sub Club Program
otherRecurring.amount: 1.9%, subject to increases of up to 10% annually, of the gross sales, for each transaction made by a Sub Club program member at your restaurant; payable weekly

otherRecurring.name: Location Rent/License Fee
otherRecurring.amount: $1,000 - $6,000 per month, estimated (paid to leasing affiliate or landlord)

item19.quote: We do not make any representations about a franchisee's future financial performance or the past financial performance of company-owned or franchised outlets.
item19.note: We do not make any representations about a franchisee's future financial performance or the past financial performance of company-owned or franchised outlets.

special: Premises are usually subleased from Doctor's Associates' affiliate leasing corporation (Sublease), with rent estimated at $1,000 to $6,000 per month; rent is not a percentage of sales. Item 7 Real Property line ($3,000-$12,000) is only a 2-month rent deposit. The system is 100% franchised (0 company-owned outlets) and shrank by 729 outlets in 2025.
issues: No Item 19 (no financial performance representation). Fee high set equal to standard $15,000 (reduced $7,500 fees listed in note).
